desc_stone_color.d: D color (colorless: no hint of color, completely white)
desc_stone_color.e: E color (colorless: very hard to notice hint of color)
desc_stone_color.f: F color (near colorless: hard to notice hint of color)
desc_stone_color.g: G color (near colorless: trained eye can notice a hint of color)
desc_stone_color.h: H color (colored: average eye can notice a hint of color)
desc_stone_color.i: I color (colored: average eye will notice a hint of color)
desc_stone_color.j: J color (colored: average eye will notice the color)
desc_stone_color.k: K color (dark color: average eye will notice the dark color)
desc_stone_color.l: L color (dark color: average eye will notice the dark color)
desc_stone_color.m: M color (very dark color: average eye will notice the dark color)

desc_stone_clarity.fl: FL clarity (Flawless: no internal or external flaws, perfect quality)
desc_stone_clarity.vvs1: VVS1 clarity (Very Very Slightly Included First Degree: hard to find flaws under a microscope)
desc_stone_clarity.vvs2: VVS2 clarity (Very Very Slightly Included Second Degree: visible flaws under a microscope, hard to find flaws under a 10X jewelers loupe)
desc_stone_clarity.vs1: VS1 clarity (Very Slightly Included First Degree: flaws are visible under a 10X jewelers loupe and and shine is not compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.vs2: VS2 clarity (Very Slightly Included Second Degree: flaws are visible under a 10X jewelers loupe and shine is not compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.si1: SI1 clarity (Slightly Included First Degree: flaws can be visible to the naked eye and shine is not compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.si2: SI2 clarity (Slightly Included Second Degree: flaws are visible to the naked eye and shine is slightly compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.si3: SI3 clarity (Slightly Included Third Degree: flaws are visible to the naked eye and shine is compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.i1: I1 clarity (Included First Degree: flaws are easily detected with the naked eye and shine is compromised)
desc_stone_clarity.i2: I2 clarity Included Second Degree: almost the lowest quality in the diamond grading scale and has limited shine)
desc_stone_clarity.i3: I3 clarity (Included Third Degree: lowest quality in the diamond grading scale and has no shine)
desc_stone_clarity.low: Low clarity is the most common purchased stone. contains some inclusions and little noticeable color.
desc_stone_clarity.medium: Medium clarity contains slight inclusions and no hint of color.
desc_stone_clarity.high: High clarity has no visible inclusions and no hint of color.
